summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 28, 2026 press release announcing that Smackover Lithium, its partnership with Equinor, amended its binding offtake agreement with Trafigura Trading LLC for the South West Arkansas Project. The amendment grants Smackover an elective option to deliver up to 4,000 additional metric tonnes of battery-quality lithium carbonate annually atop the initial 8,000 tpy take-or-pay commitment, raising maximum volumes to 12,000 tpy over the 10-year term from commercial production. Pricing terms remain confidential; no board recommendation, advisor, or change of control is disclosed.
